notes: COlchicine for acute PEricarditis. Colchicine: Reduced recurrent pericarditis 11.7% vs 40% (HR 0.25). Added to aspirin/NSAIDs. Well-tolerated. Changed practice for acute pericarditis. NEJM.

COlchicine for Recurrent Pericarditis. Colchicine: Reduced recurrence rate 20% vs 60% (HR 0.30). Landmark trial for recurrent pericarditis. Enabled colchicine as standard therapy. Annals Internal Med.

COlchicine for Recurrent Pericarditis trial 2. Colchicine: Reduced recurrence 14.2% vs 43.3% (HR 0.29). Confirmed CORP findings. Low-dose (0.5mg once daily) effective in weight <70kg. JAMA Internal Med.

Investigation on COlchicine for Acute Pericarditis. Colchicine: Reduced incessant/recurrent pericarditis 20% vs 42.5% (HR 0.44). Reduced symptom duration. First-line therapy for acute pericarditis. Circulation.
COlchicine for Prevention of Post-pericardiotomy Syndrome. Colchicine: Reduced post-cardiac surgery pericarditis 10% vs 21% (HR 0.46). Reduced postop effusions, AF. Prophylactic benefit. Circulation.

Rilonacept for Recurrent Pericarditis. Rilonacept: Reduced recurrence (pericarditis-free 74% vs 13% at 16 weeks). For colchicine-refractory recurrent pericarditis. Biologic option. FDA approved 2021. NEJM.
